obligations.requirement: One renderer-neutral BrushPrimitiveDAB representation is consumed by Android and Web Skia paths.
obligations.oracle: Cross-platform adapter tests inspect the same primitive fields and resource bindings.
obligations.acceptance: No platform renderer reconstructs spacing, size, opacity, rotation, Shape or Grain semantics from BrushDefinition.

obligations.requirement: Skia programmable-DAB rendering applies spacing, size, opacity, rotation, Shape and Grain deterministically.
obligations.oracle: Fixed fixture raster and primitive digest snapshots.
obligations.acceptance: Identical input/program/resource fixture produces identical canonical digest on the common renderer seam.

obligations.requirement: Android native Skia surface or RGBA bridge consumes the common renderer output.
obligations.acceptance: Android no longer uses Java Canvas2D as the programmable-DAB implementation path.

obligations.requirement: Web WebGL2 Skia surface consumes the common renderer output.
obligations.oracle: Web build and host contract test.
obligations.acceptance: Web playground routes brush rendering through the Skia WebGL2 surface; Canvas2D fallback is not parity evidence.

obligations.oracle: Relevant G4/G4.4/G4.5 automated suites plus scope/diff audit.
obligations.acceptance: No semantic schema, input arbitration, historical evidence, lock, WetMedia, persistence or G5 changes.

obligations.requirement: Exact Android/Web qualification artifacts are bound to the result revision.
obligations.acceptance: Durable evidence is reviewer-resolvable and status is READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW.

oracle_precondition.expected_failure: Before implementation, Android uses Java Canvas rendering and Web playground uses Canvas2D; the common Skia parity fixture must fail at the adapter/renderer seam.
oracle_precondition.observation_seam: apps/ink_playground platform adapters and runtime/render Skia backend
